assumptions: The time window is 22 to 31 October 2026, as stated explicitly in the question.
A risk decline means failure category = risk_decline, which includes ISSUER_RISK_DECLINE, RISK_RULE_DECLINE and SUSPECTED_FRAUD.
caveats: Attempt volume was 39% above the usual level for those weekdays between 22 and 31 October. Real business events such as sales and data gaps both look like this, so check before comparing totals across this period. It is not a data error by itself and is flagged for context.
The ranking shows counts of risk-decline failed attempts, not decline rates, so high-volume BINs naturally rank higher.

facts.text: There were 2,516 risk-decline failed attempts on card payments between 22 and 31 October 2026.
BIN 911001 ranked first with 371 risk-decline failed attempts (14.8% of the total).
BIN 911003 ranked second with 345 failed attempts (13.7%), and BIN 911002 third with 297 (11.8%).
The top three BINs together account for 40.3% of all risk-decline failed attempts.
Overall attempt volume in this window was 39% above the usual level for those weekdays.

response.headline: Card BINs 911001, 911003 and 911002 had the most risk declines from 22 to 31 October 2026, together accounting for 40.3% of the 2,516 risk-decline failed attempts.
